children: Infinity Natural Resources reported a combined derivative loss of approximately $64.4 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, driven by $1.2 million of realized losses and $63.2 million of non-cash mark-to-market unrealized losses. The company said these derivatives reference crude oil, natural gas, NGLs and regional basis differentials and were entered under its board-approved hedging strategy. The figures are preliminary and unaudited and subject to completion of the company’s financial closing procedures.
Combined derivative loss for Q3 2026: approximately $64.4 million (realized losses of ~$1.2 million plus unrealized mark-to-market losses of ~$63.2 million).
Realized losses from settled derivative contracts during the quarter: approximately $1.2 million (cash settlements).
Unrealized mark-to-market losses on outstanding derivative portfolio as of September 30, 2026: approximately $63.2 million (non-cash revaluation).
Fair value (mark-to-market) of open derivative positions summarized by commodity in disclosed tables (total fair value impact across instruments reflected in above unrealized amount).
Derivative contracts reference crude oil (WTI), natural gas (NYMEX and basis), natural gas liquids (NGLs) and regional basis differentials as part of the company’s hedging program.

Open swap positions include 3,395 MBbls of WTI swaps across 2026–2028 and 144.87 million MMBtu of NYMEX natural gas swaps across 2026–2030, among other positions (detailed volumes and weighted prices presented in the filing tables).
Collar positions for oil cover 465 MBbls with weighted average ceiling and floor prices disclosed for 2026–2027.
Management notes that the unrealized adjustments reflect market revaluation of contracts that remain open and do not represent current-period cash flows.
